what: Proposed drift-baseline.env write uses only a [[ ! -f ... ]] write-once guard instead of the repo's symlink-safe env-file write contract
scenario_or_breakage: A broken symlink or non-regular drift-baseline.env in DESIGN_TMPDIR can bypass -f semantics, risking an unintended write target or a failed baseline write that silently disables the drift anchor
suggested_fix: Keep write-once behavior but require symlink/non-regular refusal: only create when the path is absent and not a symlink, write via temp-plus-mv or phase_driver_write_result_env, and read BASELINE_* with an allowlist rather than sourcing the file
